What's new in Vekrun 0.6.1 — Bringing work in, and investigations that recover

• Bring work in from Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI: untick any changed file to leave it out (it stays as your last commit has it in the Factory's copy), name Gemini CLI as the source, and optionally note the tool's session id (kept only as where the work came from). The way in is always there: a link on Home when there's no card, and "Bring in unfinished work" in Search anything (⌘K).
• Production monitoring says "investigating" only while work on an error is actually running, with one badge per row. Stopped or finished work no longer leaves the label behind.
• When a local model crashes mid-investigation (Ollama's "model runner has unexpectedly stopped", usually out of memory), Vekrun starts it again on its own. If it crashes again, it says what happened and what helps, with Try again and Choose a model.
• Investigate new errors no longer skips errors whose application isn't mapped to a repository: like Investigate on one error, it reads them against the open project and says so.
